name: Retail placements (tabs, status filter, placements table, inline Checks panel with Record check form)
notes: Interaction targets: r{n}-btn-checks (expand Checks), checks (expanded panel), record-find / record-date / record-note (form fields), record-btn (Record check), status-{1..5} (filter), btn-new, row-{n}. Data from data/<region>/placements.json via scripts/la-pages-placements.mjs. Statuses planned / confirmed / not carried out are separate states: populated, filter-planned, filter-confirmed, filter-not-carried-out; zero = Cancelled filter with none; empty = no placements.
